<thought>Both the 13C NMR and IR data lack clear signatures of carbonyl groups. The only downfield carbon signal (160.8 ppm) is more typical of an aromatic carbon attached to an electronegative atom, and the IR spectrum shows no C=O stretch around 1700 cm⁻¹. Therefore, the molecule contains zero carbonyl (C=O) groups.</thought>
